statement: Does leaderboard-based LLM capability structure (inter-benchmark correlations, general-factor share, Jin et al. 2025 causal ordering) hold up under a lineage-structured (phylogenetic) covariance beyond flat corrections? Computable part: Pagel's lambda and Blomberg's K per Open LLM Leaderboard v2 benchmark on the Hugging Face fine-tune/merge genealogy, then refit the published factor results under PGLS against contributor random effects and base-model strata. First check the unread arXiv:2605.02930 (full text) and arXiv:2609.28177.

inputs.source_showing_it_is_open: Hardy et al. 2026, arXiv:2605.25272 (names hierarchical dependence, corrects only with a contributor random effect); Ilić & Gignac 2024, arXiv:2310.11616 (raises it, de-duplication only)
inputs.tier: A (part a, computational on public data); part b nearer B
inputs.how: Work it as PROMPT.md describes. Open the source first and confirm the problem is still open. State exactly what you established and what you did not.
